mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies near the Verona Public Library with temperatures at 84 degrees, and because the air quality index is at 51, it is sitting in the moderate range today.

The City is busy with projects including the Military Ridge State Trail paving, which aims to provide year-round accessibility, and the new public art installation at Century School Park that features carvings inspired by Tai Chi movements.
We have a great lineup ahead starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co. today, and live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.

Regarding local public safety, a noteworthy call occurred on August 30 when an officer discovered a collision between a vehicle and a bicyclist on East Verona Avenue, resulting in a citation for the driver.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10:00 PM today, so be sure to stop by and enjoy the delicious flavor of the day, which is Snickers Swirl.
